scoringLaw: Scores are transparent decision indices, not demand probabilities, market size, price proof, or expected revenue.

candidates.name: White-label Lead-Path Revenue Leak Evidence Sprint
candidates.buyer: US or otherwise legally approved agencies serving HVAC, plumbing, or electrical firms
whyItWins: Current seller surveys identify response speed, communication, estimates, and repair-trigger timing as material home-service workflows.
An agency relationship can unlock multiple downstream sites and supports white-label delivery.
A fixed evidence sprint can be delivered without replacing the buyer's CRM or field-service platform.
The deliverable can become a shareable proof artifact and later a recurring monitor if paid demand repeats.
candidates.promotionGate: At least one real cleared payment and customer-accepted delivery under the exact scope; repeated delivery is required before automation or recurring-product promotion.
killConditions: No qualified buyer conversation after the predeclared bounded audience window.
No buyer accepts a paid pilot after five qualified conversations.
Median founder time exceeds the packet ceiling without a reusable repair.
The evidence sprint cannot identify reproducible decision-relevant findings without unauthorized form, call, CRM, or customer-system actions.
Measured contribution is negative after provider, delivery, support, refund, and founder-minute costs.

candidates.name: AI Agent Acceptance Evidence Sprint
candidates.buyer: AI implementation agencies and software teams preparing customer-facing agents for release
whyFallback: Current agent vendors emphasize simulations, versioned procedures, diagnostics, traces, and repeated reliability checks.
Buyer-provided sandboxes and expected outcomes allow a bounded acceptance artifact with zero production actions.
The workflow can recur per agent version or customer release.
unproven: independent differentiation from native vendor testing
candidates.activationCondition: Promote only if the primary canary fails its declared buyer-access or paid-pilot threshold, or if a qualified AI-agency buyer supplies a sandbox and asks for paid acceptance evidence.
killConditions: Buyer cannot provide a sandbox, expected final states, or safe synthetic data.
The work duplicates a native test suite without adding independent evidence or hostile scenarios.
No paid pilot after five qualified conversations.

candidates.name: RFP Compliance Evidence Matrix
candidates.buyer: small consultancies responding to evidence-heavy RFPs
candidates.parkingReason: Strong bounded deliverable but weaker current buyer/distribution evidence than the two selected evidence-sprint offers.

candidates.name: Cloud SLA Credit Evidence Desk
candidates.buyer: SMBs with material cloud bills and incidents
candidates.parkingReason: Potentially provable value but requires provider-specific evidence, account access, and buyer discovery not justified by current research.

candidates.name: Generic Managed Cold Outreach
candidates.rejectionReason: Sequencing infrastructure is inexpensive and crowded, while data, compliance, sender health, provider policy, support, and outcome attribution remain costly and currently unproven. Outbound stays a distribution motion for a specific offer, not the offer itself.
